name: agent-models
description: Pins the model each subagent type runs on, set in /config or with /agent-models

explore.title: Explore agents
explore.description: Model for Explore subagents. inherit leaves the choice to the agent definition, then the main model.

other.title: Every other type
other.description: Model for any subagent type not named above or in Custom.

custom.title: Custom
custom.description: More types, as type=model pairs separated by commas: code-reviewer=opus, claude-code-guide=haiku

force.title: Override explicit models
force.description: Also replace a model the caller asked for. Off: a pin applies only when no model was given.
